newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's M1 up 1.7 percent in July.
newsitem.headline: Israel's M1 up 1.7 percent in July.

text.p: Israel's M1 money supply expanded 1.7 percent to a preliminary 16.86 billion shekels in September following a drop of 0.3 percent in August, the Bank of Israel said on Sunday.
In the first nine months of the year, the money supply grew 11.1 percent, the central bank said.

Total credit to the public increased 0.9 percent to 240.6 billion shekels in September, following an increase of 0.7 percent in August. In the first nine months, total credit rose 15.3 percent, the central bank said.
